name: MathMotion Studio palette
notes: Brand colors are MEASURED from the raster references in assets/ (pixel sampling with Pillow). The scene_format section is normative for scene.md color names and must stay in sync with prompts/SCENE_FORMAT_SPEC.md section 7.2 and the validator palette in tools/validate_scene.py.

observed: #061830 — dark logo background, app icon background
#071A32 — light logo wordmark ink (same family, export noise)
navy.role: Primary ink and dark surface; the near-black midnight navy of the identity.

violet.note: Single canonical value. Dark-context rasters render 4–8 steps deeper, which is within export/compositing tolerance; SVG variants use this canonical value everywhere.

observed: #E9EADC..#F3F6EF — dark logo wordmark and app icon mark
ivory.note: Sampled across glyph cores and anti-aliased edges; canonical value is the rounded midpoint.
ivory.role: Light ink on dark surfaces; the crisp ivory of the identity.

scene_format.source_note: navy/violet/ivory are measured brand values. The other nine are defined supporting colors for diagrams and multi-series graphs — they are not logo-derived and carry no external licensing claims.

ui_support.note: Neutral UI colors for the future application interface (MASTER-PROMPT section 3). Not implemented anywhere yet — no UI exists.

contrast_wcag_2_1.method: relative luminance ratios computed from the hex values above (WCAG 2.1 formula)
contrast_wcag_2_1.violet_on_navy: 3.2:1 (large text and UI components only — not body text)
contrast_wcag_2_1.guidance: For text on navy, use ivory, never violet. For text on white, navy is preferred; violet is acceptable at ≥18.66px bold or ≥24px.
